package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	sectionuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/section"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// SectionHandler handles section endpoints.
type SectionHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  sectionuc.CreateSection
	UpdateUC  sectionuc.UpdateSection
	DeleteUC  sectionuc.DeleteSection
	GetUC     sectionuc.GetSection
	ListUC    sectionuc.ListSectionsByModule
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

type sectionTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type sectionCreateRequest struct {
	ID               string                      `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey        string                      `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	TechID           *int                        `json:"tech_id" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Status           *int                        `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess    `json:"lesson_read_access" validate:"omitempty,oneof=guest student student_pro disabled"`
	Translations     []sectionTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

type sectionUpdateRequest struct {
	TechID           *int                        `json:"tech_id" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Status           int                         `json:"status" validate:"oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess optionalLessonReadAccess    `json:"lesson_read_access"`
	Translations     []sectionTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

func (h SectionHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req sectionCreateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionuc.CreateSectionInput{
		ID:               req.ID,
		SourceKey:        req.SourceKey,
		TechID:           req.TechID,
		Status:           req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess: req.LessonReadAccess,
		Translations:     mapSectionTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h SectionHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	var req sectionUpdateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionuc.UpdateSectionInput{
		ID:                  sectionID,
		TechID:              req.TechID,
		Status:              req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess:    req.LessonReadAccess.Value,
		LessonReadAccessSet: req.LessonReadAccess.Set,
		Translations:        mapSectionTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h SectionHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	item, translations, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionID)
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	fields := queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.SectionAllowedFields)
	sectionResponse := buildSectionFields(*item, translations, fields, resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")))
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"section": sectionResponse, "translations": sectionResponse["translations"]})
}

func (h SectionHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := r.URL.Query().Get("module_id")
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.SectionAllowedFields)
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	if moduleID == "" && !privileged {
		writeModuleError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if !privileged {
		if err := h.Access.RequireModule(r.Context(), moduleID); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	items, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionuc.ListSectionsInput{
		ModuleID:   moduleID,
		ActiveOnly: !privileged,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	response, err := h.mapSectionListResponse(r, items, fields)
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"sections": response})
}

func (h SectionHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionID); err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func mapSectionTranslations(translations []sectionTranslationRequest) []domain.SectionI18n {
	result := make([]domain.SectionI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.SectionI18n{
			I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
			Title:       translation.Title,
			Description: translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}
